text:
Alex Kim: Orbit Alliance hit a blocker on AcmeHealth private deploy. Installer failing on post-install network fetch. Can @Priya run the arch review?
Priya Menon: on it. do we have the installer logs or kube events? who from Orbit is on the line?
Alex Kim: partner contact is Evan (orbit-evan). installer error: `Failed to fetch /metadata/keys: dial tcp 10.0.0.5:443: connect: network is unreachable`
Mike Carter: sounds like egress/NAT. their VPC might not allow our registry/KMS IPs. check NAT gateway and proxy rules.
Jordan Patel: confirm HSM/KMS FQDNs too. govcloud customers have different hostnames.
Priya Menon: Evan says: "on-prem VPC peered to customer edge, only outbound 443 to a small IP set allowed". likely registry IPs missing from allowlist.
Sarah Li: can engineering produce authoritative FQDN + IP ranges and a minimal ACL snippet? partner needs quick cut-and-paste.
Mike Carter: example registry ranges: `34.128.0.0/14`, `35.224.0.0/12` (placeholder). better to provide FQDNs: `registry.redwood-inference.com`, `kms.<region>.redwood-inference.com`.
Priya Menon: Evan also mentioned marketplace attestation pinning. If they only allow SNI, FQDNs will help. can eng produce a short runbook + fallback options?
Alex Kim: @Jordan please draft a 1-pager with: required outbound ports, FQDNs, cert thumbprint verification, quick tests, and a fallback relay option. Need to share with Orbit PS by EOD.
Jordan Patel: will do. include steps: `curl -v https://registry.redwood-inference.com/v2/`, `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect kms.<region>.redwood-inference.com:443`, where to pin cert thumbprint. fallback: mirror via staging relay.
Oncall Bot: Incident #P-2024-011 created for Orbit Alliance deploy; severity: medium; assignee: Priya Menon.
Priya Menon: partner checklist to post back: 1) confirm NAT/egress IPs include registry/KMS OR allow FQDN via proxy; 2) validate route to `kms.<region>.redwood-inference.com:443`; 3) ensure marketplace signing cert chain is present; 4) attach `kubectl -n redwood logs <installer-pod>` if still failing.
Alex Kim: they can only update perimeter ACLs during a maintenance window. any short-term workaround?
Mike Carter: ops can enable a temporary relay: partner uploads image artifact to our staging SFTP, we mirror into a subnet accessible during window. requires Ops approval ~3h.
Priya Menon: Ops approval needed. Evan wants an ETA for a go/no-go call.
Jordan Patel: timeline in runbook: immediate triage tests (10-30m), temporary mirror (3h ops lead time), full ACL change in scheduled window.
Sarah Li: loop in Marketplace: mirrored images may need re-attestation. Jordan include attestation/sign steps in runbook.
Evan (orbit-evan): fyi we tried proxy tweak, still hit TLS handshake when fetching keys. sending full logs to Priya.
Priya Menon: copy received. Evan please post `kubectl describe pod <installer-pod>` and `journalctl -u installer.service` output after maintenance window so we can correlate.
Alex Kim: thanks team, Jordan please share draft runbook in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
